template.name: template_tabbedsocialitem

event.name: onTouchDrag
event.params: component, element, x, y, relX, relY

template.event:
if(element:name() == "leaderboard") then element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("show") print("LEADERBOARDS SELECTED") element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("displayLeaderboardInfo") game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgDeselectItems() ) element["selectionOverlay"]("visible"):SetInt(1) elseif(element:name() == "help") then element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("show") element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("displayHelpInfo") game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgDeselectItems() ) element["selectionOverlay"]("visible"):SetInt(1) --[[game.startHelpMenu()]] elseif(element:name() == "sound") then element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("show") element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("displaySoundInfo") game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgDeselectItems() ) element["selectionOverlay"]("visible"):SetInt(1)
--[[ game.setSoundEnabled( not game.isSoundEnabled() ) playSoundFx("audio/sfx/menu_button_down.wav") ]] elseif(element:name() == "logout") then element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("show") element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("displayLogoutInfo") game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgDeselectItems() ) element["selectionOverlay"]("visible"):SetInt(1) else element:root():GetElement("Frame"):DoStoredScript("show") game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgDeselectItems() ) element["selectionOverlay"]("visible"):SetInt(1) game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgSetStoreItemSelected(element("ItemId"):GetInt()) ) game.engineReceiver():Send( game.MsgItemSelected( false ) ) end
